hypothesis.statement: MetaHuman Identity Solve can technically succeed while preserving an unattractive or incorrect face, so solve success alone must not authorize conform.
hypothesis.action: Require immutable front, both profile and Template A/B captures, an authorized named reviewer, canonical 03/06/07/08 comparison, explicit keep/reject decision and zero blocking findings before conform.
hypothesis.expectedResult: A technically solved but visually wrong face remains a valid rejected iteration and cannot become the production MetaHuman.

qualityBoundary: This contract does not claim that Identity Solve has run. It ensures MetaHuman cannot merely render the existing ugly MPFB proportions at higher fidelity and pass automatically.
decision: The first real solve should default to reject unless the user can recognize the canonical identity in front and both profiles.
